responsibility: Provides rustc_expand’s parser-facing support layer and validates its behavior through regression tests. In this module, the tests exercise the string-based parser entry points and associated parsing utilities, covering token-stream and token-tree construction, span and delimiter preservation, attribute and doc-comment handling, pattern identifier spans, parse error reporting, and helper code-pattern matching. Together, this module’s responsibility is to ensure that expansion-related parsing support produces correctly structured tokens and spans and reports errors consistently across the parser utilities it exposes.
